subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should shared reply-session code own permanent conflict recovery while Discord retains only a bounded abortable retry?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 implement recovery at different layers, and leaving both uncoordinated risks divergent channel behavior and lifecycle policy.

options.title: Shared recovery plus narrow retry
options.body: Use shared session recovery as canonical and keep an abortable Discord retry as bounded defense in depth.

options.title: Channel-only recovery
options.body: Keep the complete conflict-recovery policy in each affected channel and do not add shared self-heal.

recommendation.title: Shared recovery plus narrow retry
recommendation.body: Use shared session recovery as canonical and keep an abortable Discord retry as bounded defense in depth.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the central Discord handler and shared session-lifecycle decisions.
